intent: A country harvest-festival gown — a wheat-and-poppy crown, slim cream chemise sleeves with a red-banded cuff, a dark laced bodice front and back over a red sash, and a full wheat-gold skirt flared from hip to hem over a white linen apron — reading from the high camera as a narrow top over a wide gold bell.
requests: A warmer wheat gold than the bible's trim limits allow; inside them the harvest skirt reads olive-grey at the high camera.
A tapered (trapezoid) cloth panel, so a full skirt can widen smoothly instead of as overlapping straight panels.
